Offline text reading, comparison and editing of separate copies. No accounts, ads, analytics, or network permission.

History, open documents and bookmarks store references and reading metadata, not document contents. Bookmarks also keep names you enter and a source fingerprint to detect changes. Clear bookmarks separately from history. Sharing or opening a file with another app creates a temporary copy. Old copies are cleaned on the next app start or share after 24 hours; only the latest 20 are kept.

Edit a copy explicitly retains one private content-bearing recovery checkpoint, excluded from backup. Resume it from home. Discard or a successful save of the matching revision removes it; failed or cancelled saves keep recovery. Very recent typing may be lost on process termination. Original files stay unchanged.

Open file
Choose a document through Android’s system picker. This is also the fallback when another app does not offer Textr.

Open with and Share
In a file manager or another app, select a file, choose Open with or Share, then choose Textr. Shared text can also be viewed. Textr’s own Share file and Open with actions send a read-only copy to another app.

Choosing a default
When Android offers Always, you can select Textr as the default. The available choices depend on the sending app and the reported file type (MIME type), not just the filename extension. Some apps always use their own viewer. Textr cannot force an association for every extension.

Unavailable recent files
Recent files and open documents store references, not contents. A moved or deleted file, or an expired temporary permission, may require you to select it again using Open file. Clearing history does not delete your files.

Older text files
If text cannot be decoded or looks wrong, try Reopen with encoding. Your choice only changes how Textr reads the bytes; it does not convert the file.

Offline viewing
Textr has no network permission. A document provider selected in the system picker may independently use the network to retrieve your file.

Saved HTML
Open a local HTML file, then choose Markdown reading view from the display-mode button. The original source stays available. HTML shared as content can also be read; a shared website URL stays text. Scripts and remote images are not loaded.

Reading settings
Size, wrapping, font and spacing can follow global defaults or use Only this document. Source stays monospace.

Structure and formats
JSON/XML Structure offers navigation and explicit copy actions while keeping original source. Source colors include .env, .properties, Dockerfile and TypeScript/TSX. TSV uses the CSV table with Tab as its initial delimiter; explicit table choices are remembered.

Export, comparison and copy editing
Save Markdown as creates a new file from HTML reading output. Compare source uses two read-only snapshots; Ctrl+Up/Down navigates changes, and compact/large-text windows use unified view. Edit a copy opens original TXT/Markdown source in a separate editor, up to 256 Ki characters. Undo/redo uses Ctrl+Z/Y; Ctrl+F finds/replaces literal text and Ctrl+S saves a new copy. A private recovery copy persists until discarded or its matching revision is saved. Resume it from home; process recovery restores the last completed checkpoint. Originals are never overwritten.
Keep open and recent files beside the reader on an unfolded phone or tablet. The sidebar hides when space is limited or system text is enlarged.
Choose a delimiter explicitly. The first row stays data unless you choose to use it as the header. Source text and shared bytes are unchanged.

Bookmarks keep approximate positions and file references independently of history and open documents. Changed files and layouts may move the position. Choose a bookmark to open, rename, reconnect or delete it.

Ctrl+O — Open file Ctrl+F — Find in the current view Ctrl+G — Go to line in source view Ctrl+Tab — Next open document Ctrl+Shift+Tab — Previous open document
Document switching follows alphabetical filename order. Shortcuts leave text fields, dialogs and menus in control. Reader actions are available after loading; Go to line requires a source view. Standard copy, selection and system shortcuts are unchanged.

resources.string: HTML reading preview is limited to 256 Ki characters. The full source is available.
Size, wrapping, font and spacing change the global defaults unless Only this document is selected. Reset removes this document’s override when you tap Done.
Select an entry for navigation or copy actions. Values copy exact source.
Navigation unavailable: malformed, unsupported, or over the 256 Ki character / 2,000 node / 64 level budget. The complete source remains available. DTDs and entity declarations are unsupported.
Copy limit: 64 Ki characters. Select from source instead.
Conversion could not complete within the reading-view limits. Original source remains available; no partial Markdown will be exported.
Save the Markdown reading content as a new UTF-8 file. Images, scripts, forms and hidden content are omitted. Review the result before reuse.
Saving %1$s was cancelled. The source remains unchanged.
Destination refused for %1$s: a new content document is required. The source was not opened for writing.
Saving %1$s was interrupted. Please inspect any output before retrying.
Could not save %1$s. The source remains unchanged; choose another destination and try again.
A possibly incomplete document remains at %1$s. Inspect or remove it with your file manager.
= unchanged · − removed on left · + added on right

Comparison unavailable within its limits: 512 KiB and 256 Ki characters per input, 10,000 lines, 16,384 characters per line, and a bounded change search. Original files remain available in the reader.
Comparison cancelled. Choose or reload an input to try again.
Cannot read this input. Choose another file or restore access, then reload.
The shared snapshot was lost after the process ended. Choose that input again.
Decoded text is identical, including line endings. Encodings or BOMs may differ.
Choose both inputs. Snapshots are read-only; reloading captures a new version. Ctrl+Up/Down moves between changes.
A source changed since its captured version. The comparison was refreshed and its position reset.
Copy editing accepts TXT and Markdown up to 256 Ki characters, 10,000 lines and 4,096 characters per line. The requested input or change exceeds an editor limit; existing text is unchanged.

This edits a separate source copy. Textr stores one private recovery copy containing the text, excluded from backup. It remains until you discard it or successfully save that revision to a new file. Process recovery restores the last completed checkpoint; very recent typing may be lost. Clearing app data or uninstalling removes recovery. The original file is never overwritten.
A recovery copy already exists. Resume it and save or discard it before starting a different copy.
No recovery copy can be opened. Return to the reader to start a new copy. If private storage is unavailable, restore storage access first.
Recovery could not be updated. Keep this editor open and save a copy; the previous checkpoint is retained.
Private recovery copy is up to date.
Saved revision confirmed; recovery copy removed.

Choose a new output file. Existing text and line endings are preserved. New lines follow a uniform original CRLF/CR convention; mixed endings insert LF. Characters that cannot be encoded cause a visible failure.
Save the copy using %1$s and the selected BOM setting? This changes the output format; original bytes and existing text/newlines remain unchanged.
Save this revision to a new file, discard the private recovery copy, or cancel to continue editing.
First %1$d matches · navigation limited; Replace all scans the complete bounded buffer.
Delete the private recovery copy and close this editor? Original and saved output files remain unchanged.
Replace all %1$d matches throughout this copy? This is one undo step and does not save a file.
Open the saved copy now to add its reference to the reader. Future access depends on the selected provider.
Replacement is limited to 4 Ki characters. The previous replacement text is unchanged.
Access was denied or permission has expired. Select the file again to request access.
The provider could not open this file. It may have moved, been deleted, or be temporarily unavailable. Retry or select it again.
The document provider stopped responding. Retry when it is available or choose another file.
The system file picker could not be opened. Your current document is kept.
Selecting a different file opens it with its own reading settings. Existing bookmarks and recovery drafts stay with their original document.
You selected a different file. Reconnect this bookmark and its reading position only if this is the same document at a new location. Open separately keeps the bookmark unchanged.
The private recovery copy could not be read. Retry or return to files; the copy is kept. Discard permanently removes it.
Permission to save %1$s was denied. Your source is unchanged. Choose another destination with Save a new copy.
The destination for %1$s is unavailable. Your source is unchanged. Try Save a new copy when the provider is available, or choose another destination.
%1$s contains characters that cannot be saved in the selected encoding. Your source is unchanged. Use Save a new copy and choose a suitable encoding, such as UTF-8.
This document is too large to copy all at once (limit: 256 Ki characters). Use Share file or select a smaller part. Nothing was copied.
Could not copy the document. Try again or use Share file.
The converted Markdown is too large for the clipboard. Use Save Markdown as instead. Nothing was copied.

Select nonblank text up to 1,000 characters. The previous search is unchanged.
Open a document in Textr to search selected text.
Enter a line number from 1 to %1$d.
Draft comparison snapshots were lost after the process ended. Return to editing and compare again; the original is never reread automatically.
Exact diff exceeds the export/comparison limits. Both snapshots are unchanged.
Equivalent under the active filters; the original decoded texts differ.
Display filters are active; saved diffs still include exact changes.

Filters affect this view only. Spaces/tabs means ASCII space and tab anywhere within each line; blank lines and Unicode whitespace remain significant. Line-ending filtering also ignores a missing final terminator.
The saved patch includes exact changes, even differences hidden by the display filters. UTF-8, three context lines, fixed anonymous filenames. Originals remain unchanged.
Each physical line is listed, including invalid records and blank lines. Select a line to jump or copy its exact source, including its terminator. No duplicate keys are collapsed.
Record navigation exceeds its limits: 256 Ki characters, 1,000 physical lines, 16,384 characters per valid record, depth 64 and 200,000 tokens. The complete source is available.
Replace the reference to %1$s with the document you just selected? The original file is unchanged.
Delete this collection and its references? Provider files and other collections are unchanged.
Open a file first, or all recent documents are already in this collection.
References only. Clearing recent history keeps collections. Up to 20 collections, 30 references each, 200 memberships total. Removing references never deletes files.
Use a unique, nonempty name up to 80 characters. Limits: 20 collections, 30 references per collection, 200 memberships total; no duplicate references.
